definition: the right person, book or idea arriving exactly when I needed it

settled:
I take it that God reaches different people differently. For Nephi revelation came in words; for Lehi in dreams and visions. The channel is matched to the recipient.

For me it comes as exposure: the right person, book, idea or thought arriving at exactly the right time, when I did not know that was what I needed. Every major change in my life seems to have followed this pattern.

Words and visions are closed to me, and I generate no alternatives of my own, so outside is the only way in.

That is what makes this channel the clearest one: a door I could not have made appearing exactly when it fits.

I run no test on a candidate. I always follow the path of what is more true, and I cannot choose what to believe, so a false one simply does not stick.

The same deficit is the cost and the gift. I cannot believe my way out of misery, and for the same reason a false revelation cannot take root in me.
